legacy_interval_reporting.note: Observed-design point estimates on original scores: G for relative decisions, Phi for absolute decisions, and error variances / SEMs. Pointwise approximate logit-delta intervals under independent normal random effects for objects, declared random facets and their interactions. Component covariance uses a Gaussian plug-in model, including uncertainty in every random facet. These are not simultaneous bands, prediction intervals or distribution-robust intervals. Relevant nonpositive raw components and boundary coefficients withhold intervals; small facet samples can still give poor coverage. Fixed-facet conditioning remains conditional.

Pointwise 95% Wald intervals for sensitivity checks under the listed fixed population SD. Conditional holds the anchor values fixed. Independent calibration adds their full covariance without a cross-sample term. Shared calibration combines both stages' influence for each work. Interpret these diagnostic intervals using coverage evidence for the sampling model and assignment.

legacy_interval_reporting.note: Severity logits for one prespecified contrast. Positive means the first rater is relatively stricter in the first group. When shown, the interval and Wald test are fixed-SD model approximations. An interval spanning zero can include differences large enough to matter. Coverage evidence is specific to the simulated models and assignments. Inspect shared works, tasks and rubric use. Conditional bias diagnostics are exploratory.
